hero.headline: The medical system is overwhelming. You shouldn't have to navigate it alone.

problem.heading: You need an advocate when the stakes are too high to navigate alone.
problem.lead: You or someone you love has received a serious diagnosis. The appointments are overwhelming, the terminology is impenetrable, and your doctors are brilliant — but busy.
problem.body: You are forced to make decisions that matter enormously, with incomplete information, under extreme time pressure. And in complex healthcare, a wrong turn costs far more than any fee.
problem.punchline: Most families don't know what they don't know — until it's too late.

services.heading: What I Do
services.intro: I step in to manage the clinical details so you can focus on your family.

items.title: Record Review & Translation
items.description: I read every page of your medical records and translate what matters into plain language.

items.title: Second Opinion Coordination
items.description: I know which institutions lead in which specialties. I facilitate the right second opinion, fast.

items.title: Provider Communication
items.description: I communicate directly with your care team in clinical language so nothing is lost in translation.

items.title: Appointment Navigation
items.description: I prepare you before every appointment and debrief with you after so you understand your options.

advocate.heading: Meet Your Advocate
paragraphs: With 18 years of clinical experience as a Physician Assistant specializing in oncology, bone marrow transplant, and orthopedics, I have seen the healthcare system from the inside.
I know what it takes to get answers, and I know how easily things can fall through the cracks when a patient's care spans multiple specialists, brilliant doctors, and busy institutions.
advocate.philosophy: My commitment is simple: I sit on your side of the table, speak your doctors' language, and make sure you have the clarity to make the right decisions.

professionals.heading: For Professionals
professionals.intro: I serve as a specialized resource for estate attorneys, wealth advisors, and concierge physicians.
professionals.description: I complement your practice by translating the clinical side of the equation, ensuring your clients are as well-informed medically as they are legally.
professionals.quote: Clinical integrity is my priority. I do not pay or receive referral fees.
professionals.author: Kim — Patient Advocate, PA-C
